from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInterestIncome(BaseModel):
    """Interest income reported in one company's financial statement for the period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as named in the report")
    interest_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Interest income amount as reported in the statement")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the amount (e.g., '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    source_line: str = Field(description="Verbatim description of the line item where this value appears")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_interest_incomes: list[CompanyInterestIncome]
